import pandas as pd

def format(path):
    # Read the CSV file
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    
    # Check if the 4th column exists and is of time type
    if df.shape[1] < 4:
        raise ValueError('The CSV does not have a 4th column.')
    
    # Reduce every time value in the 4th column by 3 hours
    df.iloc[:, 3] = pd.to_timedelta(df.iloc[:, 3]) - pd.Timedelta(hours=3)
    
    # Write the adjusted data to an Excel file
    df.to_excel('/workspace/audit-export.xlsx', index=False)
